_comment: Outline crossing cases shared by tests/test_geometry.py (geometry._find_crossing, Python) and tests/outline.test.mjs (builder/outline.js findCrossing, JavaScript). Both must give exactly these messages (null = no crossing), so the builder's live errors match what the server says on save.

cases.name: figure of eight
cases.expected: Walls A and D cross each other.

cases.name: wall doubling back
cases.expected: Walls A and B double back over each other.

cases.name: corner touching another wall
cases.expected: Walls A and D cross each other.

cases.name: notch closing on itself
cases.expected: Walls B and E cross each other.
